cta: NRG Bloom is building its public voice around what the records already prove.

scenes.text: Here is a simple rule for African compute: no site, no authority.
NRG Bloom has been operational at Ogboinbiri since February 2025.
NRG Bloom has documented site operations at Ogboinbiri beginning in February 2025.
Operating continuity matters because frontier infrastructure fails first in execution, not in concept decks.
Teams that can show dated operating proof earn the right to shape the market conversation.
In frontier infrastructure, the most valuable marketing asset is not polish. It is documented operating history.
Proof comes first. Narrative comes second.

title: Proof Before Promises
